children: Integrated private 5G networking and mobile video technologies provide reliable, high-quality live video transmission for sports broadcasting and live production environments
MONTREAL, Sept. 02, 2026

, a global leader in mission-critical, real-time video networking and visual collaboration solutions, today announced that it will showcase advanced mobile video transmission workflows in partnership with

at IBC2026. Demonstrations will be available on both the Haivision and Riedel stands, giving visitors two opportunities to experience the integrated wireless video ecosystem powered by Haivision mobile transmitters and Riedel’s Easy5G Private 5G solution.

Haivision and Riedel are combining their respective strengths to deliver a seamless, end-to-end wireless production solution that enables broadcasters to capture, transmit, and manage live video with exceptional mobility, reliability, and ultra-low latency at under 100 milliseconds. Together, the companies are demonstrating how private 5G connectivity and broadcast-grade mobile video encoders can unlock new levels of flexibility for live events, sports, remote productions, and any environment requiring a guaranteed quality of service.
Visitors will be able to see how Haivision and Riedel solutions work together in a scalable wireless video workflow designed using the following technologies:
Falkon Mobile Video Transmitter
Portable 5G mobile video transmitter delivering ultra-low latency, broadcast-quality 4K UHD and HD streaming over bonded cellular networks from anywhere.
Haivision MoJoPro Mobile Camera App
Professional mobile journalism app enabling bonded cellular/Wi-Fi transmission, video returns, and IFB.
Haivision StreamHub Receiver & IP Gateway
Centralized routing to SDI, NDI, ST 2110, SRT, HLS, RTMP, and more, with integrated transcoding, recording, and remote device control.
Riedel Easy5G Private 5G Network

Wide-coverage private 5G system delivering reliable, high-throughput wireless connectivity for dense broadcast environments. Easy5G is available both as a fully managed service and as a standalone product, giving broadcasters flexible deployment options for wireless video, audio, intercom, and data workflows.

“Our partnership with Haivision continues to demonstrate the transformative potential of private 5G for the media and entertainment industry,” said Jacky Voß, Executive Director Strategy & Innovation, Riedel Communications. “The combination of Easy5G and Haivision's cellular video transmission solutions delivers a seamless end-to-end workflow that enables broadcasters to capture and transport high-quality video with exceptional mobility and reliability. We look forward to showcasing these capabilities together at IBC2026.”

“The integration of Haivision’s mobile transmission technology with Riedel’s Easy5G platform creates a powerful foundation for next-generation wireless production,” said Peter Maag, Chief Strategy Officer and Executive Vice President, Haivision. “Together, we’re delivering a seamless, end-to-end workflow that sets a new standard for what broadcasters can expect from mobile contribution.”

Visitors can see the joint demonstrations throughout IBC2026 at both the Haivision stand (Hall 2, 2.B32) and Riedel stand (Hall 10, 10.A31). To schedule a meeting with Haivision at IBC2026, visit: https://www.haivision.com/events/ibc/
About Haivision

Haivision is a leading global provider of mission-critical, real-time video networking and visual collaboration solutions. Haivision enables organizations globally to engage audiences, enhance collaboration, and support decision-making. We provide high-quality, low-latency, secure, and reliable live video at a global scale. Haivision open-sourced its award-winning SRT low-latency video streaming protocol and founded the SRT Alliance to support its adoption. Awarded four Emmys® for Technology and Engineering from the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences, Haivision continues to fuel the future of IP video transformation. Founded in 2004, Haivision is headquartered in Montreal and Chicago with offices, sales, and support located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia. To learn more, visit Haivision at www.haivision.com.

About Riedel

The Riedel Group, led by founder and Group CEO Thomas Riedel, unites a diverse portfolio of technology companies and service providers with complementary expertise across media, sports, entertainment, and related markets. Its core operating businesses are Riedel Communications, comprising the Product Division and Managed Technology Division, and Riedel Networks, which provides global network solutions and services.

Riedel Communications is a leading provider of live production technologies and services. Its hardware and software portfolio spans distributed video and audio networks, intercom systems, live video production and broadcast control systems, and Private 5G networks. These offerings are complemented by managed technology expertise and services for complex live productions and events. Together, this broad portfolio enables customers to execute projects on-site, remotely, or in the cloud. Headquartered in Wuppertal, Germany, Riedel Communications employs more than 1,000 people in 30 locations across Europe, Australia, Asia, and the Americas.
Further information about Riedel and its solutions is available at www.riedel.net.
